title: Align live AI-facing current-state files with HS_FAST_REFRESH.json
trigger: ChatGPT review 2026-05-12 (archived in cross_check_archive/chatgpt_change_control_design_2026-05-12.md) identified multiple live AI-facing files contradicting HS_FAST_REFRESH.json on current engine versions, CNQ shipped status, and investigation count. Claude verified all four drift claims against the live working repo and confirmed each. The drift is real and risks misleading any AI session or external reviewer that encounters the stale files instead of HS_FAST_REFRESH.json.
change_summary: Bring all live AI-facing files into agreement about current CNT/CNQ engine versions, CNQ shipped status, investigation count, corpus count, and CCTT current-or-legacy status.

Do not change engine code (would be S4 packet).
Do not modify expected_results.json (would be S4 packet).
Do not modify CLAIM_STRENGTH_TABLE.md content (would be S5 packet).
